definitions.gloss: common expense fee; common area maintenance fee
definitions.explanation: A fee paid by tenants or owners for the maintenance of shared facilities and common areas in an apartment building or condominium.

examples.japanese: {共益費|きょうえきひ}は{水道代|すいどうだい}を{含|ふく}んでいる。
examples.english: The common expense fee includes the water bill.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}{8万円|はちまんえん}、{共益費|きょうえきひ}{3千円|さんぜんえん}。
examples.english: Rent 80,000 yen, common expense fee 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {共益費|きょうえきひ}で{廊下|ろうか}の{照明|しょうめい}が{賄|まかな}われている。
examples.english: The hallway lighting is covered by the common expense fee.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{共益|きょうえき} (common benefit) + {費|ひ} (expense, fee)

DIFFERENCE FROM {管理費|かんりひ}:
While often used interchangeably, technically:
・{管理費|かんりひ} - more for management/administration
・{共益費|きょうえきひ} - more for shared utilities/facilities

In practice, many landlords use one or the other, and some use both.

WHAT IT TYPICALLY COVERS:
・{共用|きょうよう}{部分|ぶぶん}の{電気|でんき} (common area electricity)
・{水道|すいどう}{代|だい} (water bills - sometimes)
・{ゴミ}{処理|しょり} (garbage disposal)
・{廊下|ろうか}/{階段|かいだん}の{清掃|せいそう} (hallway/stairway cleaning)

PROPERTY LISTING TERMS:
・{賃料|ちんりょう}：¥80,000 {共益費|きょうえきひ}：¥5,000
・{共益費|きょうえきひ}{込|こ}み (common fee included in rent)
・{共益費|きょうえきひ}なし (no common fee)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{共益費|きょうえきひ}を{払|はら}う (to pay the common expense fee)
・{共益費|きょうえきひ}が{発生|はっせい}する (a common fee applies)
・{共益費|きょうえきひ}{別|べつ} (common fee charged separately)
